limitations.note: The rewrite fixed counting across invalid cycles but also made ready_a high during reset and changed valid_b from a registered count check to a pulse only when the sixth bit is accepted.
The test passed because it expected ready_a to stay high through reset and valid_b to assert only on sixth-bit acceptance, so it could not flag either departure from the reference behavior.
The knowledge-base search returned no matches and did not inform the fix.
